exposure: vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) hysterectomies
mode of delivery for previous pregnancies
cohort: 106 patients who underwent hysterectomy for large uteri (weight >280 g) at a French tertiary university hospital
finding: vNOTES hysterectomy for large uteri (>280 g) is associated with decreased operative time, a shorter hospital stay, and increased performance in the ambulatory setting compared to the laparoscopic approach.
